project_info.name: ReCircle infiTex Private Limited Landing Website
project_info.target_audience: Textile Manufacturers, Brand Partners, Recyclers, Chemical & Mechanical Processors, ESG & Sustainability Executives
project_info.description: India's largest textile recovery facility (1,200 MT/month of polyester textile waste in Sachin GIDC, Surat) - A Joint Venture between ReCircle and Alliance InfiTex.

motion_and_effects.lenis_smooth_scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled globally using @studio-freight/lenis or lenis library.
motion_and_effects.framer_motion: Hero line-by-line masked text reveal on load, scroll triggered entry animations for sections, kinetic numbers counter for 1,200 MT/month, chapter markers fade-in, image hover zoom & spotlight effects.
motion_and_effects.parallax: Subtle parallax hero image scaling on scroll.
motion_and_effects.marquee: One slow, elegant editorial ribbon marquee with low contrast and massive item gaps.

sections_sequence.name: 1. Sticky White Header
sections_sequence.components: Logo left (ReCircle infiTex lockup in Royal Blue #01298A and Eco Green #11821A), nav menu center/right with anchor links (#facility, #why-surat, #capacity, #how-it-works, #tech, #products, #partners, #about, #contact), 'Get in Touch' CTA button on far right, responsive mobile slide-over sheet or hamburger menu with data-testid attributes.

sections_sequence.name: 2. Hero Section
sections_sequence.bg: Full-width industrial facility photo with #01298A (Royal Blue) overlay (opacity 0.45-0.55)
sections_sequence.content: Left-aligned vertically-centered content. Chapter marker '01 / OVERVIEW'. Eyebrow 'RECIRCLE INFITEX PRIVATE LIMITED'. H1 line-by-line masked reveal animation: 'Textile Recovery. Built for Scale.' Subheadline: 'Operating India's largest textile recovery facility processing 1,200 MT/month of polyester textile waste in Sachin GIDC, Surat.' Primary CTA button 'Partner With the Facility' (anchors to #contact) + White Ghost secondary button 'See How It Works' (anchors to #how-it-works).

sections_sequence.name: 3. Intro Strip
sections_sequence.content: Max width 800px. Chapter marker '02 / CIRCULARITY'. Centered H2 'Leading India's Shift to Textile Circularity'. High-impact paragraph highlighting the JV between ReCircle and Alliance InfiTex transforming industrial & post-consumer waste into high-grade circular feedstocks.

sections_sequence.name: 4. Joint Venture Section
sections_sequence.content: Section H2 'Two Companies. One Recovery Ecosystem.' 3-card grid: Card 1 'Industrial and Scalable', Card 2 'Tech-Driven and Transparent', Card 3 'Authoritative and Collaborative'. Each card features an industrial photo, card number, Royal Blue headline, and Graphite body copy.

sections_sequence.name: 5. Why Surat Grid
sections_sequence.content: Section H2 'Why Surat: The Heart of India's Textile Hub'. 6-item icon grid: (1) Yarn Manufacturing, (2) Weaving and Knitting, (3) Process Houses, (4) Garmenting Setups, (5) Textile Markets, (6) Aggregators. Custom Phosphor/Lucide icons with Royal Blue styling, hover elevation, and clean typography.

sections_sequence.name: 6. Capacity Stat Section
sections_sequence.bg: bg-[#01298A] text-white py-24 px-6 lg:px-12 border-t border-b border-[#01206d]
sections_sequence.content: Huge kinetic stat lockup: '1,200 MT/month'. Headline 'Massive Capacity Engineered for Industrial Recovery'. 2 columns: Column 1 'Industrial & Pre-Consumer Waste', Column 2 'Municipal & Post-Consumer Waste'. Supporting line highlighting throughput reliability and zero-landfill diversion in Sachin GIDC.

sections_sequence.name: 7. How It Works - Technical Workflow
sections_sequence.content: Centered header 'How It Works: End-to-End Recovery Flowchart'. Full-width 4:3 technical workflow flowchart container (max-w-1200px) mapping Sourcing -> NIR Automated Sorting -> Baling & Shredding -> Mechanical/Chemical Feedstock Dispatch. Features interactive tap-to-expand Lightbox for mobile/tablet inspection.

sections_sequence.name: 8. Technology Section
sections_sequence.content: Section H2 'Advanced Recovery Technology'. 2-column layout: Column 1 'AI-Based Automated Sorting' (NIR spectrographic identification of fiber compositions up to 99% purity), Column 2 'End-to-End Traceability' (Digital batch tracking, QR-coded bales, chain-of-custody ESG reporting).

sections_sequence.name: 9. Buy Our Recovered Material
sections_sequence.content: Section H2 'Buy Our Recovered Material'. 2 product cards: Card 1 'Mechanical Recycling Grade 100% Polyester' (shredded fiber/chip grade for rPET spinning), Card 2 'Chemical Recycling Grade 80%+ Polyester Blend' (depolymerization ready feedstock). Proof line: 'Supplying certified circular feedstocks to partners like Alliance Fibres Limited for rPET filament yarn production.' Primary CTA 'Request Product Specifications & Samples' -> anchors to #contact.

sections_sequence.name: 10. Strategic Partnerships
sections_sequence.content: Section H2 'Strategic Partnerships'. 2 detailed partnership cards: Card 1 'Alliance Fibres Limited' (Pioneering synthetic waste recycling & rPET yarn manufacturing), Card 2 'CAIF by Intellecap' (Circular Apparel Innovation Factory fostering ecosystem scale and policy alignment).

sections_sequence.name: 11. Dark Vision Section
sections_sequence.bg: bg-[#000000] text-white py-24 px-6 lg:px-12 text-center
sections_sequence.content: Max width 800px. Chapter marker '05 / VISION'. Centered H2 'A Paradigm Shift in Textile Waste Management'. Expressive quote framing India's leadership in global textile sustainability, zero-waste industrial parks, and closed-loop polyester infrastructure.

sections_sequence.name: 12. About ReCircle Section
sections_sequence.content: 2-column layout: Left column = ReCircle branding & corporate profile (pioneering waste management enterprise diverting 100,000+ MT waste with tech-first traceability), Right column = ReCircle narrative, leadership focus, and sustainability milestones.

sections_sequence.name: 13. About Alliance InfiTex Section
sections_sequence.content: Mirrored 2-column layout: Left column = Alliance InfiTex narrative, deep textile manufacturing lineage in Surat, engineering prowess in fiber recovery, Right column = Alliance InfiTex brand showcase & operational capability.

sections_sequence.name: 14. Contact & Enquiry Section
sections_sequence.bg: bg-white py-24 px-6 lg:px-12 border-t border-slate-200
sections_sequence.content: The ONLY form on the site. 2-column layout: Left = Headline 'Build Circularity Into Your Supply Chain' + Company Details (Facility Address: Plot No. C-1, Sachin GIDC, Surat, Gujarat 394230; Phone: +91 95370 07436; Email: info@recircleinfitex.in; Corporate Identifiers: CIN & PAN details; Operating Hours & Regional Office), Right = Enquiry Form with fields (Name, Company Name, Email Address, Phone Number, Reason for Enquiry [Select: Partnership / Buy Recovered Material / Waste Collection / Facility Tour / Other], Material Interested In [Select: Mechanical 100% Polyester / Chemical 80%+ Blend / Custom Sorting / General Enquiry], Quantity Required [MT/month], Message textarea, 'Send Enquiry' primary button) with toast feedback using Sonner.

sections_sequence.name: 15. Footer
sections_sequence.bg: bg-[#01298A] text-white pt-16 pb-8 px-6 lg:px-12
sections_sequence.content: Knockout white ReCircle infiTex logo, brand tagline, 3 link columns (1. Company Anchors: Facility, Technology, Materials, Partners, Vision, About; 2. External Partners: ReCircle.in, Alliance Fibres, CAIF Intellecap; 3. Direct Contact: Surat Facility, +91 95370 07436, info@recircleinfitex.in). Bottom copyright bar: '© 2026 ReCircle infiTex Private Limited. All rights reserved.'

testing_and_data_attributes.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on every button, input, anchor, modal, card, and interactive element.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling is initialized in App.js or smooth scroll wrapper.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line headline reveal in Hero section and staggered entry animations.

Follow exact color codes: Royal Blue #01298A (Primary), Eco Green #11821A (Accent), Graphite Charcoal #2C2C2C (Secondary text), Facility Slate Light #F4F6F8 (Surface), Pure Black #000000, Pure White #FFFFFF.
Strict typography rules: Inter font only. Maintain exact font size and weight hierarchies.
Include tap-to-expand lightbox for the workflow flowchart image on mobile/tablet viewports.
Ensure all interactive CTAs smooth-scroll to #contact section or respective anchor targets.
Add sonner toast confirmation when contact enquiry form is submitted.
Every single interactive button, form element, and nav link MUST have a valid data-testid attribute.
